CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.rpc_save_push_sub(pw text, p_player text, p_endpoint text, p_p256dh text, p_auth text)
 RETURNS json
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
AS $function$
BEGIN
    INSERT INTO push_subscriptions (player_name, endpoint, p256dh, auth, updated_at)
    VALUES (trim(p_player), p_endpoint, p_p256dh, p_auth, now())
    ON CONFLICT (endpoint) DO UPDATE
    SET player_name = EXCLUDED.player_name,
        p256dh = EXCLUDED.p256dh,
        auth = EXCLUDED.auth,
        updated_at = now();

    RETURN json_build_object('ok', true);
END;
$function$
